title: Android 1.16.0 download
summary: The website's Android download is now version 1.16.0: the map's press-and-hold wheel vibrates in the app, and the owner's Field monitor widget waits longer for its reading.
items: Downloads offers Android 1.16.0 with its checksum; install it over the existing app. Saved campaigns, sign-in and placed widgets are kept.
The app now includes the Open5e search and party chat fixes from October 30.
